E4Plus1.uk.description: Mojito: Gordon Ramsay visits a Cuban café in Brooklyn, where owners Marcelo and Kata fight over everything, driving away customers with their high-volume bickering. (S3 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Cafe Notte: Unresolved tension between head chef Jerry and his co-owner stepson David is threatening to destroy both their business and their family. (S10 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's Dessert Week. The bakers take on a self-saucing Signature and a trip down memory lane on retro dessert trolleys. Who'll roll merrily along, and whose wheels will come off? (S17 Ep5/10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Forgive and Regret: Grampa, thinking he's about to die, reveals a terrible secret. Can Homer forgive him? (S29 Ep18/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Left Behind: Flanders loses his job and comes to work with Homer at the power plant. Homer prays for him to be fired. (S29 Ep19/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Throw Grampa from the Dane: The Simpsons visit Denmark and all fall in love with it - except Homer. Meanwhile, Grampa needs a serious operation. (S29 Ep20/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rednecks and Broomsticks: Homer discovers that Cletus and his pals are making moonshine. Lisa gets to know three teenage Wiccans. Guest starring Neve Campbell. (S21 Ep7/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boy Meets Curl: When Homer takes Marge out for a romantic evening at the ice rink, they become hooked on curling and end up competing to reach the Winter Olympics. (S21 Ep12/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Color Yellow: Lisa finds her ancestor Eliza Simpson's diary, which describes a remarkable 19th-century adventure. (S21 Ep13/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Squirt and the Whale: The Simpsons put up a wind turbine in their back garden. Lisa has an upsetting experience when she attempts to free a beached whale. (S21 Ep19/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: To Surveil with Love: When a bomb squad blows up Homer's unattended gym bag, radiation is released into Springfield, and the authorities react by suspending civil liberties. (S21 Ep20/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Lego Masters Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Grand Finale: Our top three teams have a whopping 28 hours to create finale showpieces. Who'll be crowned the best Lego builders in the galaxy and win $100,000? (S7 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Independence Day: Resurgence
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2016) Sci-fi blockbuster sequel starring Jeff Goldblum and Liam Hemsworth. Twenty years after Earth repelled a devastating alien invasion, the extraterrestrials return to finish the job.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: A compilation of family-friendly highlights from series 27.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: One Born Every Minute
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: A new generation of parents give a glimpse into the reality of childbirth. Erin and Kalem meet baby number two. Faye and Will prep to become first-time parents. (S12 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Aaron from Texas moved to London 10 months ago and is still figuring out how to charm British women. His date Sophie says few men can resist her well-practised stare. (S4 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: M3GAN
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Creepy-doll horror with Allison Williams. A robotics engineer simultaneously invents an AI dolly and takes on the care of her orphaned niece. But can a cyborg really raise a kid?

E4Plus1.uk.title: One Born Every Minute
E4Plus1.uk.description: A new generation of parents give a glimpse into the reality of childbirth. Erin and Kalem meet baby number two. Faye and Will prep to become first-time parents. (S12 Ep1) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ladies of London: The New Reign
E4Plus1.uk.description: Friction spreads through the group as Mark-Francis and Margo's standoff continues at Longleat. And the tension soon becomes too much for Margo. (Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ladies of London: The New Reign
E4Plus1.uk.description: The group attend Joshua's fashion show, where a harmonious end to the season is scuppered when Martha finally finds her voice - much to Margo's dismay. (Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sabotage: Peralta thinks someone's trying to sabotage his professional life, but Santiago and Diaz aren't convinced. Boyle, Hitchcock and Scully work on a tricky case. (S2 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: A mystery is unravelled as we journey back in time to a chance encounter. Meanwhile, Jenson turns sinister when he faces rejection. And Abigail continues to abuse her position of power. [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Confessions are made and secret feelings are revealed. Jenson turns sinister as he's faced with rejection. And Frankie's first day at the hospital is off to a distressing start.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jenson's past is quickly catching up to him, and Theresa finds herself in the middle of a dangerous mess. Elsewhere, Abigail continues to abuse her position of power...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rob and Rich, and Simon and Lauren, take on former World's Strongest Man, Eddie The Beast Hall, and his wife Alex, as they compete to host the best dinner party in Stoke-on-Trent.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: PJ's Steakhouse: In New York, Gordon Ramsay visits PJ's Steakhouse, where owners Joe and Madalyn are in serious debt and struggling to keep the high-end restaurant afloat. (S3 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fleming: Gordon Ramsay visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami. Once the best family-run restaurant in town, it's now losing money fast. (S3 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Returns 1: Gordon revisits three restaurants - Handlebar, Casa Roma and The Black Pearl - to check in with the owners he helped. Has his advice been put to good use? (S3 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Leap Day: Cameron's birthday falls on 29 February, and with the celebrations coming but once every four years, there's loads of pressure on Mitchell to get it right. (S3 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Walt: Claire supports Luke when his friend Walt dies. Phil takes Alex for some father-daughter bonding time, and Haley throws an unauthorised party. (S3 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Great Wife Hope: The male citizens of Springfield become obsessed with the brutal sport of Ultimate Punching, and Marge ends up getting challenged to step into the ring... (S21 Ep3/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XX: Bart and Lisa seek revenge on their teachers. Krusty's latest snack turns Springfield's citizens into zombies. Moe's beer is tainted with Homer's blood. (S21 Ep4/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Devil Wears Nada: Marge becomes famous when she poses for a racy charity calendar. Mr Burns promotes Carl to supervisor. (S21 Ep5/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.: A British secret agent comes to Springfield on the trail of a Russian spy. Guest starring Stephen Fry. (S32 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Han Ukkah Solo: When Beverly talks Erica into writing a Hanukkah song for the school holiday concert, she inspires Barry to prove his own musical prowess. (S4 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: O Captain! My Captain!: Beverly hopes to inspire the students when she takes over as substitute teacher in Barry's chemistry class. Adam embarrasses Emmy. (S4 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Future Dunphys: When Phil takes Claire to the hospital for her angiogram, they meet a family who are basically their future selves. They're not sure they like what they see. (S4 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Flip Flop: Phil is confident that he can sell Claire and Cam's renovated house, but when it proves harder than he thought, he resorts to desperate measures. (S4 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Career Day: Phil is chuffed to share the wonders of residential real estate with Luke and Manny's classmates for career day, but unfortunately his nemesis, Gil Thorpe, shows up. (S4 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Hero: Mitch's ex Teddy, a very personable and successful doctor, invites the family to a fundraising event at the local roller rink, where they all run rings around each other. (S4 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Star of the Backstage: Marge gets nostalgic about her days as stage manager of her high school play and reunites the cast for a re-run. They say you should never go back... (S33 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart's in Jail!: When a phone scammer who's pretending to be Bart fools Grampa into giving away $10,000, it's Homer who's the real victim. According to Homer, anyway. (S33 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XXXII: Another Halloween helping of spooky tales, featuring some chilling takes on classic films including Parasite, Nightmare on Elm Street and, er, Bambi. (S33 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Judge Me Tender: Moe becomes a judge on American Idol. Meanwhile, Homer spends more time at home, and drives Marge to distraction. Simon Cowell and Ellen DeGeneres guest star. (S21 Ep23/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: There's horror in the woods for two McQueens, and tension rises when Kathleen-Angel is caught between her boyfriend and her best friend. Elsewhere, can a couple move past recent events?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sabotage: Peralta thinks someone's trying to sabotage his professional life, but Santiago and Diaz aren't convinced. Boyle, Hitchcock and Scully work on a tricky case. (S2 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bev dates Howard, a former bank manager with a famous face. And Anthony, who has a wild past, meets Lawrence, who's never been in love and thinks his 'dating river has run dry'. (S14 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: With Sam Prince's antics in question, is Arman a better match for Maali? Inga's back and needs Jack's advice on Jazz. And James takes issue with Freddy and Beks. (S32 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the box this time: Coronation Street, Love Island, Sex Actually with Alice Levine, Starstruck, Cheat, Dancing on Ice, and Catfish UK. (S21 Ep2)
